meta.title: 终于，FinalCut 也能用的自动剪辑工作流
meta.title_en: An Auto-Editing Workflow for Final Cut, Finally
meta.topic: 剪辑 · Final Cut · 自动化

scenes.title_cn: 从 Pr 迁移到 FCP：自动剪辑的复活
scenes.title_en: From Premiere to Final Cut: Auto-Editing Revived
scenes.context: 作者此前在 Premiere 里用了一套 Skill 驱动的自动剪辑流程，迁移到 Final Cut 后这套流程复活了。把素材、提示词交给 AI，自动产出分镜初稿。
sentences: 我在 Premiere 里一直在用的这套自动剪辑工作流，终于能用在 Final Cut 上了。
The auto-editing workflow I've been using in Premiere finally works in Final Cut.
workflow（工作流）
它把剪辑变成提需求。
It turns editing into asking for what you want.
ask for what you want（提出需求）
AI 产出的是分镜初稿，不是成品。
The AI delivers a storyboard draft, not a finished cut.
storyboard draft（分镜初稿）
paraphrase: The machine assembles the first pass for you.
You direct, the AI assembles, you polish.
scenes.speak: The auto-editing workflow I've been using in Premiere finally works in Final Cut. It turns editing into asking for what you want. The AI delivers a storyboard draft, not a finished cut.

scenes.title_cn: 三要素输入：剧本、素材与参考样片
scenes.title_en: Three Inputs: Script, Footage, and a Reference
scenes.context: 工作流的核心输入是三样东西：脚本（每段时长建议）、素材库（镜头清单）与参考样片（节奏与风格参照）。模型按这三样拼出第一版。
sentences: 第一步，给出你的脚本，包括每段建议的时长。
Step one, provide your script, including a suggested duration for each segment.
suggested duration（建议时长）
第二步，整理素材库，列出每个镜头的清单。
Step two, organize your footage and list every clip you have.
footage（素材）
模型会参照参考样片决定每一刀剪在哪。
The model uses the reference to decide where every cut lands.
reference（参考样片）
paraphrase: Know your inventory before you ask the machine to cut.
「给 AI 一个范本」换种说法
Show it an example of the pace you want.
scenes.speak: Step one, provide your script, including a suggested duration for each segment. Step two, organize your footage and list every clip you have. The model uses the reference to decide where every cut lands.

scenes.title_cn: 初稿出来后的手艺人工作
scenes.title_en: The Craft Still Lives in the Second Pass
scenes.context: AI 初稿把三分之二的骨架搭好，剩下的是人类剪辑师的手艺：节奏卡点、情绪留白、B-roll 时机。重点是流程是『草稿快，人磨精』。
sentences: AI 把骨架搭好了，但灵魂是人给的。
The AI builds the skeleton, but the soul comes from you.
skeleton（骨架）
节奏、留白、卡点，这些是初稿给不了的。
Pacing, breathing room, and hit points — a first draft can't give you those.
pacing（节奏）
草稿要快，定稿要人磨。
Draft fast, and let a human finesse the final cut.
finesse（精修）
paraphrase: It saves you the tedious assembly, not the taste.
The machine organizes; the editor decides.
scenes.speak: The AI builds the skeleton, but the soul comes from you. Pacing, breathing room, and hit points — a first draft can't give you those. Draft fast, and let a human finesse the final cut.

scenes.title_cn: 价值与边界：提效 5 倍，但品味不可外包
scenes.title_en: Value and Limits: 5× Faster, But Taste Isn't Outsourced
scenes.context: 流程让创作从『一天剪完』变成『一小时出稿』，但要到能用的水平仍需人把关。AI 不懂为什么这刀要剪，它只懂结构上的合理性。
sentences: 同样是成片，我把时间从一天压到了一小时。
The same finished video now takes an hour instead of a day.
finished video（成片）
AI 不懂为什么，它只懂合理。
The AI doesn't understand why — it only understands what's coherent.
coherent（合理的）
所有决定性的审美判断，仍然要由人来做。
Every decisive aesthetic call still has to be made by a human.
aesthetic call（审美判断）
paraphrase: Speed comes from the draft; quality comes from the pass.
Don't blame the tool for a bad brief.
scenes.speak: The same finished video now takes an hour instead of a day. The AI doesn't understand why — it only understands what's coherent. Every decisive aesthetic call still has to be made by a human.

practice: 「给 AI 提供脚本和素材」怎么表达？
Feed the AI your script and footage.
「AI 出初稿，人出灵魂」用英文怎么说？
The AI drafts, and the human adds the soul.
Draft fast, finesse the final cut.
pitfalls: Expect the AI draft to be the final video.
Treat the draft as a storyboard to be edited over.
The first pass is assembly; taste is the editor's job.
Organize your footage and list every clip.
The model can only cut what you inventory clearly.
Provide a reference for pace and style.
Without a reference, the model has no north star for rhythm.
Blame the AI when the cut feels off.
Review the brief and the footage list first.
Most weak cuts come from a weak brief, not a weak model.
shifts: 用脚本+素材+参考三要素驱动初稿
把剪辑当提出高质量需求+审美把关
担心 AI 取代剪辑
理解 AI 承担组装，人承担判断
